lens: Words on screen and their evidence: structural text (grammar.md principle 5), how faithful the quotes are, claim support, whether screen and narration agree, and source lines/credits
overall: The evidence work is careful. Every K.quote I checked matches its source verbatim, with the correct page: Qureshi line 161, Commission pp. 3, 79, 181–182, 269, 271, 272, 353, 400, 417–418, CIA IG p. xv, and the S-1's 'founded in 2003' and 'in the wake of the attacks on September 11th'. The quote_zh renderings mostly keep their qualifiers. The two versions of the 11 June meeting (Wright vs Commission) are kept apart with per-card tags, and the series' own comparisons are dashed and labelled. The one factual error is in the 一本护照 chain. The Dubai passport copy, with the US visa highlighted in blue, sits under '1999 年底', but Wright, the Commission (n.44, cable of 4 Jan 2000) and the CIA IG (5 Jan 2000) all put it in early January 2000. The next row then shows the CIA 'learning' about the visa a second time. The 几种解释 labels also tend to drop their sources' hedges ('may be best explained' became 'Wright 认为最可能'; IG's 'apparently' and Bryant's 'could' are gone; Soufan's 'I don't know why' became 原因至今不明). Smaller issues: a doubled closing quote mark that K.quote produces; about 11 s where the Commission column is on screen with only a Qureshi source line; and the Qureshi phrase worded differently on screen (很有价值) and in narration (有用) at the same moment. Note: verification/screen-text-ep05.md does not exist, so I worked from scenes.js and two rendered sheets (scratchpad/review/ep05/a.png, b.png, c-0149.000.png, c-0213.000.png).

findings.element: Date cell '1999 年底' heading the Wright card whose third line is '迪拜：复印护照，内有美国签证' (visa in blue), followed by the row '2000 年 1 月 · 得知 Mihdhar 持美国签证'
findings.problem: The passport copy is dated late 1999. It actually happened in early January 2000, and it is the same event the next row reports. The timeline therefore shows the CIA seeing the visa twice, a month apart.
findings.evidence: Wright, The Agent ¶37 dates only the Hada phone call to 'the end of 1999'. ¶38 puts the Dubai break-in 'en route to Malaysia', and Commission p.181 dates that trip to the 5–8 January 2000 meeting. Commission ch.6 n.44 (p.502) cites the CIA cable 'Khalid Revealed', Jan. 4, 2000, for the photocopied passport and its visa. The CIA IG summary p.xv has the travel message drafted on 5 January 2000. Commission p.182 says 'in January, when word arrived of Mihdhar's visa'. Frames 88.5 s and 104 s show both cards stacked. scenes.js lines 160–161 and 176–177.
findings.fix: Keep only '电话得知：马来西亚聚会' and 'Khalid al-Mihdhar（米赫达尔）' under '1999 年底'. Move '迪拜：复印护照，内有美国签证' (tag Wright 报道) into the 2000 年 1 月 row beside the Commission card, so the two sources show as two accounts of one January event. Optionally have b4's narration say 二〇〇〇年一月初 for the Dubai stop.

findings.element: Pick tag 'Wright 认为最可能' over '威胁信息过多 / 未看出这一条的分量'
findings.problem: The tag hardens Wright's hedged wording into a probability ranking. It also disagrees with the narration heard at that moment ('他自己觉得最说得通的一种').
findings.evidence: The Agent ¶44: 'the C.I.A.'s failure to inform the F.B.I. may be best explained by the fact that the agency was drowning in a flood of threats…'. Ledger lt.ag-overload limit: 'Wright 自己在此处也没有断言动机'. Narration b11 says 最说得通, the screen says 最可能. scenes.js line 292.
findings.fix: Use the narration's own term and keep the hedge, for example 'Wright：或最说得通' or 'Wright 看来最说得通'. Use the same wording in narration and tag.

findings.element: Labels '共享过多，断送前程' (Commission column), '格式不对或需修改' (IG column), '原因至今不明' (Soufan column)
findings.problem: Each condensed label drops a qualifier its source states, and the narration keeps. Bryant said sharing 'could be' a career stopper. The IG says 'apparently' because of format. Soufan says he personally does not know why, and the label turns that into an objective 'unknown to this day'.
findings.evidence: Commission p.79: 'too much information sharing could be a career stopper'. Narration b12: 可能断送前程. CIA IG p.xv: 'Apparently because it was in the wrong format or needed editing, the message was never sent.' Narration b13: 看样子. Memorial transcript 00:59:13: 'frankly, I don't know why. I still don't know why… I have my own assumptions.' Narration b14: 他到现在也不知道为什么.
findings.fix: Use '共享过多，可能断送前程', '看来因格式不对或需修改', and '他至今不知原因' (or '不知原因'). Separately, the hand-typed English '“career stopper”' label skips K.quote, against AUTHORING's no-hand-written-English-quote rule. Render it from lt.rep-bryant or drop the English.

findings.element: Quote lt.rep-email ending 'certain “problems.””' and quote lt.rep-needtoknow '…a demonstrated “need to know” before sharing.”'
findings.problem: K.quote wraps quote_en in double curly quotes without converting the inner double quotes. The email quote ends in a stacked ”” that reads as a typo, and the need-to-know quote has same-type nested quotes.
findings.evidence: Full frame c-0149.000.png shows 'resource we had at certain “problems.””'. kit.js line 185 is el(q, 'kq-en', '“' + c.quote_en + '”'). Both ledger quote_en strings contain inner “…”.
findings.fix: In K.quote (film/kit.js, main session), turn inner “ ” into ‘ ’ before wrapping, giving 'certain ‘problems.’”' and '‘need to know’'. quote_en stays verbatim in the ledger.

findings.element: Source line under the two-column comparison; the left column is '九一一委员会 · 网络设计' with five Commission items
findings.problem: The line '本系列的对照：The 9/11 Commission Report, pp. 417–418 · Qureshi 2024' fades out at T(b22,'没有一手材料')−0.3. For the remaining ≈11 s the Commission's design items stay on screen, and the only citation is 'Nabeel Qureshi, Reflections on Palantir, 2024'. That line also sits under the row '设计来源：无一手材料', which is the series' own check (lt.inf-parallel), not Qureshi's statement.
findings.evidence: Word timing: '没有一手材料' starts at 348.93 s. The comparison fades at T(lt.b23)−0.5 = 359.46 s. Frames 350 s and 358.8 s show only the Qureshi line. scenes.js lines 528–530.
findings.fix: Keep the '本系列的对照' line until the comparison leaves (T('lt.b23') − 0.5). Attach the Qureshi credit to the third limits row only, or fold it into that line ('… · Qureshi 2024'). In the same line, match the episode's style: 'The 9/11 Commission Report, 2004, pp. 417–418 · Nabeel Qureshi, 2024'.

findings.element: quote_zh of ov.qureshi_why_looming_tower ('…这段背景很有价值。') and the limits row 'Qureshi 的理由 | 这段背景很有价值'
findings.problem: Qureshi's one sentence appears in two wordings at the same moments. Narration says 这段背景有用 (b1, and b22's 'Qureshi 说的只是：这段背景有用'), while the screen shows 这段背景很有价值. The quote_zh also leaves out the English's opening clause 'The Looming Tower was obvious enough', which the narration does render (发这本书的理由很明显).
findings.evidence: Snapshot qureshi-reflections-on-palantir.html.txt line 161: 'The Looming Tower was obvious enough – the company was founded partly as a response to 9/11 … and the context was valuable.' On screen at 30 s the zh begins 公司创立…. The lim row appears at T(b22,'说的只是')−0.3 = 357.2 s.
findings.fix: Pick one rendering of 'the context was valuable' (这段背景有价值) and use it in narration b1/b22, the quote_zh and the lim row. Render the dropped clause in quote_zh: 'The Looming Tower 的用意够明显——公司创立，部分是为了回应 9/11……'.

findings.element: Red slot '无人问起，他也没说'
findings.problem: This structural label is a clause pair lifted from the narration ('可是没人问他，他也没说'). It keeps the colloquial 也 and a dangling 他, and its form differs from the other slots in the same chain (未送到 / 未给).
findings.evidence: grammar.md principle 5: '不从正文或旁白里截取句子 … 不带口语助词和悬空的指代 … 同类位置形式并列'. Sibling slots read '未送到' and '未给'. Commission p.269: 'No one at the meeting asked him what he knew; he did not volunteer anything.'
findings.fix: Use a condensed parallel form such as '未被问及，未主动说明' or '无人问，未主动说'.

findings.element: Network nodes '规则：给或不给', '审计记录', '数据本身 / 来源与手段' vs comparison items '查询由规则决定给或不给', '每次查询留下审计记录', '数据与来源、手段拆开'
findings.problem: The same Commission items reappear 30 s later in different words. The comparison column also mixes forms: a colon label, a full clause and a topic-comment phrase. '先发：最广可共享的版本' and '权限设在数据层' are repeated verbatim, so the rest are visibly inconsistent.
findings.evidence: scenes.js lines 434–445 vs 498. grammar.md principle 5: '同一句话在几处出现时逐字一致 … 同类位置形式并列'.
findings.fix: Reuse the b20 wording in the comparison column ('数据与来源、手段拆开' can stay as the first item; then '规则：给或不给', '审计记录'), or bring all five into one verb-object pattern.

findings.problem: The same source is credited in several styles within the episode: 'Lawrence Wright, The Agent, The New Yorker, 2006' / 'Lawrence Wright, The Agent, 2006' / 'The Agent, 2006'; 'CIA Office of Inspector General, Executive Summary, 2005' / 'CIA OIG Executive Summary, 2005'; 'Ali Soufan, The Looming Tower panel, 9/11 Memorial & Museum, 2018' / '9/11 Memorial panel, 2018'; and 'The 9/11 Commission Report, pp. 417–418 · Qureshi 2024', which drops the year and author name.
findings.fix: Use one form per source, for example 'Lawrence Wright, The Agent, The New Yorker, 2006' and 'CIA OIG, Executive Summary, 2005, pp. …', shortening only in the multi-source line at b3.

findings.problem: In the standalone episode, FDE is never spelled out on screen or in narration. ep00 and ep03 define it ('forward deployed engineer … 驻到客户那边的工程师'), but ep05 does not. The label is also close to a cut from the narration ('是 FDE 要做的一件要紧的事'). The chapter tag uses 驻场, so the closing term and the chapter name never meet.
findings.evidence: grep: FDE is first defined in episodes/00-overview/script.json and 03-getting-things-done/script.json; ep05 b23 is its only use. grammar.md principle 6: abbreviations are spelled out once on each page a reader can enter directly.
findings.fix: Spell it out once in this episode, for example label '驻场工程师（FDE）的一件要紧事', or add '驻场工程师' to b23's narration.

lens: The picture as a viewer experiences it with the narration: sync, pacing and holds, layout and legibility, visual grammar, images
overall: Most of the episode keeps time with the narration. Listed items arrive on their words: the chain rows, the four reason columns, the three label chips, the specialist boxes, the network nodes and the closing diagram. Transitions dip through paper for under half a second, and no text runs off its box or past the margins. The most urgent problem is a code bug in the first body segment. The blue mark on "回应 9/11" never appears, so the screen sits unchanged for about 11 s while the narration covers the company's founding reason. The second must-fix is a dating error in the passport chain. The Dubai passport copy with its US visa sits under "1999 年底", but the next row, citing the Commission, dates the visa to January 2000, so one event is shown on two dates. Beyond those: the chain draws source-stated failures in red dashes although dashes are reserved for the series' own reading; a short camera move slices the top row's text; and some smaller layout and image points are listed below.

findings.element: scene lt-book, Qureshi quote (.lt-mark spans 'founded partly as a response to 9/11' / '回应 9/11')
findings.problem: The first blue mark never appears. At 31.0 s the narration says '公司成立，有一部分是在回应九一一' and nothing on screen responds. The quote then sits unchanged for about 11 s while the narration moves on to Peter Thiel and civil liberties.
findings.evidence: In scenes.js, mark() (lines 30–36) rewrites el.innerHTML on every call. The second call for 'the context was valuable' / '这段背景很有价值' therefore detaches the span the first call returned. A DOM probe found exactly four tweens whose targets are detached: color tweens at 30.89 and 37.6 on 'founded partly as a response to 9/11' and on '回应 9/11'. At t=33 the computed color of that span is rgb(13,24,38), which is ink. A pixel count of the quote area found 0 blue pixels at 31.3 s and 3,273 at 38.0 s. The only tween activity between 26.6 and 37.6 is that detached tween.
findings.fix: Insert all marks in one pass. For example, give mark() a list of phrases, build innerHTML once, and return el.querySelectorAll('.lt-mark') in order; or wrap each phrase with a Range on its text node instead of reassigning innerHTML. Optionally add a beat at T('lt.b1','公民自由') that marks 'the inevitable violations of civil liberties' / '无可避免的对公民自由的侵犯', so the Peter Thiel clause also gets a visible beat. Re-check that the 9/11 phrase is blue at about 33 s.

findings.at: 74.4–109 (card at 79.2; '内有美国签证' blue at 87.6; Jan 2000 row at 92.2)
findings.element: scene lt-chain, row '1999 年底' card: '迪拜：复印护照，内有美国签证' (Wright 报道), and the next row '2000 年 1 月 · 得知 Mihdhar 持美国签证' (委员会报告)
findings.problem: The same event appears on two dates. The Dubai passport copy that revealed the visa is filed, and highlighted in blue, under '1999 年底'. The next row, citing the Commission, says the CIA learned of the visa in January 2000. A viewer reads two separate discoveries, and the 1999 date is wrong for the Dubai line.
findings.evidence: Ledger: lt.ag-nopass dates only the phone intercept ('约 1999 年底'). lt.ag-passport (the Dubai hotel-room copy) carries no date. lt.rep-visa-not-shared dates the visa knowledge: '2000 年 1 月 CIA 得知 Mihdhar 持美国签证'. The passport copy is the source of that knowledge, so it belongs to January 2000 (Mihdhar passed through Dubai on his way to the Kuala Lumpur meeting in early January 2000). In frames 87.9 and 94.2, '内有美国签证' sits in the 1999 row directly above '得知 Mihdhar 持美国签证' in the January 2000 row.
findings.fix: Keep '1999 年底' only for '电话得知：马来西亚聚会 / Khalid al-Mihdhar'. Move '迪拜：复印护照，内有美国签证' into the '2000 年 1 月' row. Either merge it with the Commission line, tagged 'Wright 报道 · 委员会报告', or give it its own row dated '2000 年 1 月初'. Put the blue visa beat on that row. The narration in lt.b4 places the Dubai entry in the 1999 sentence too; the narration owner should check it as well.

findings.element: lt-chain: red dashed lost links, dashed '未送到' / '无人问起，他也没说' / '未给' slots, dashed TIPOFF box; lt-field: red dashed line inside the dashed '本系列的读法' frame
findings.problem: Dashes carry two meanings. In the chain they mark failures that a source states: the Commission and Wright say these messages and records did not reach the FBI or the watchlist. Everywhere else, dashes mean the series' own reading. At 368–376 both meanings share one screen: dashed person boxes and frame for the series' reading, a red dashed line for 'did not arrive'. The undelivered link in the June 2001 request row also points the wrong way. It runs from the FBI card toward the CIA and stops short, which reads as 'the request never arrived', but the source says the CIA refused the request.
findings.evidence: scenes.css lines 1–2 define 'Red dashed: a message that did not arrive', and .lt-slot, .lt-watch use '2.5px dashed var(--red)'. The settled grammar is solid = stated by a source, dashed = the series' own reading. The chain's sources are lt.rep-visa-not-shared, lt.rep-dave and lt.ag-june11, all source-stated. Frame 133.1 shows the line from '探员索要出生日期与护照号' (FBI) running left to a stop bar beside '未给' (CIA).
findings.fix: In lt-chain, draw the undelivered links as solid red lines that end in the existing stop bar. Draw the slots and the TIPOFF row with a solid red outline, or as red text with no frame. For the June request row, run the line from the CIA '未给' slot toward the FBI card and stop it short, like the other rows. In lt.b23, make the 'not delivered' line solid red as well, so dashes inside the reading frame mean only 'our reading'.

findings.element: lt-chain .lt-view after the camera move at T('lt.b6')-0.5
findings.problem: The 62-px camera move that brings the TIPOFF row into view cuts through the top row. The date '1999 年底' and the line '电话得知：马来西亚聚会' are sliced in half under the header rule for about 3.6 s. After the scroll to June, the bottom edges of the March 2000 card and its slot stay visible under the rule as stray grey and dashed strokes for the whole June section.
findings.evidence: Full frame 106.8: the date and first card line are cut horizontally by the mask, and the card's top border is missing. Crop of frame 118.5: a solid grey stroke at x≈440–1040 and a dashed stroke at x≈1200–1720, just under the header rule above the receded TIPOFF row.
findings.fix: Remove the small move. Tighten the row gaps (30/24 px down to about 12/10) and the card padding so the TIPOFF row ends inside the 670-px view. If a move is kept, scroll by a whole row, so the cut falls in a gap, and recede the 1999 row to 0.3 opacity as the June move does. In June, scroll far enough that the March card's edges leave the view, or hide the rows above the TIPOFF row.

findings.element: lt-field comparison table: left '权限设在数据层' (row 4) ↔ right '行级规则' (row 3); blue dashed link drawn diagonally
findings.problem: In a two-column table, side-by-side boxes read as pairs. On the screen, '查询由规则决定给或不给' sits beside '行级规则', and '权限设在数据层' sits beside '安全标记'. The actual match is a diagonal link. The narration's 'only two overlaps' is clear from the blue, but the row layout suggests a different pairing.
findings.evidence: Full frame 358.6: the matched pair spans rows 3 and 4, while the unmatched '安全标记' sits on the same row as '权限设在数据层'.
findings.fix: When Qureshi's four boxes move across, give them target rows so that '行级规则' lands beside '权限设在数据层' and '审计记录' beside '每次查询留下审计记录' (for example rows 2, 4, 3, 5 for 按角色给权限, 行级规则, 安全标记, 审计记录). Both blue links then run straight across.

findings.element: lt-reasons Wright column label 'Wright 认为最可能'
findings.problem: The label claims more certainty than the source or the narration. Wright offers the overload explanation as the one that perhaps best explains events, and the narration says '最说得通'. The screen says 'most likely'.
findings.evidence: lt.ag-overload: 'CIA 未告知 FBI 的缘由或许最好用……来解释'. The narration at 182.7 says '他自己觉得最说得通的一种'.
findings.fix: Relabel it 'Wright 认为最说得通'.

findings.element: lt-book source cards (.lt-src .kfig credits; 'Ali Soufan' card image)
findings.problem: On the 350-px cards, the four-line credit strips cover about a quarter of each image. On the Commission report cover, the credit text sits on top of the cover's own subtitle, so two layers of text overlap. The Soufan card shows the FBI headquarters building in Washington under his name, while the Wright card shows Wright's face, so the convention changes from card to card. Soufan worked in the New York office.
findings.evidence: Full crop of frame 70.2: 'National Commission on Terrorist…' overlaps 'TERRORIST ATTACKS UPON THE UNITED STATES' on the cover. The ledger has no Soufan portrait; the card uses lt.fbi-hq-fbi-gov-photo.
findings.fix: Set credit beneath the image (outside the frame, at 20 px) on these small cards, or carry the credits in the bottom source line. For Soufan, either caption the photo as the institution ('FBI 总部') or use a text-only card in the same layout.
